issues.description: Mismatch in grouping identifier for Aufgabe 04: the problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 122-123) asks for sums grouped by "Regierungsbezirk" and the name of the respective Regierungsbezirk, but the reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql) groups by the column "kreis" while selecting the column "regierungsbezirk" (SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) ... GROUP BY kreis). This is inconsistent: selecting a non-aggregated column (regierungsbezirk) that is not present in the GROUP BY will cause SQL errors in standards-compliant databases (or produce nondeterministic results in permissive modes) and will confuse students about the intended grouping key.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the grouping key consistent between problem text and solution. Option A (recommended if intent is to group by Regierungsbezirk): change the solution to group by regierungsbezirk, e.g. "SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk" and update the template accordingly. Option B (if intent is to group by Kreis): change the problem text to ask for grouping by Kreis and adjust the solution to either select only kreis and aggregated values or include regierungsbezirk in the GROUP BY as well (e.g. "GROUP BY kreis, regierungsbezirk"). Ensure the template, solution, and task text all use the same column name for grouping to avoid student confusion and SQL errors.
